description: This file defines the module 'node:sea' which provides APIs related to Node.js's single executable application feature, including functions for detecting if the code runs inside such an app and retrieving embedded assets. It also contains extensive comments explaining the usage, creation, injection, signing, and execution of these single-executable applications.

methods.name: function isSea(): boolean; isSea
methods.description: Returns whether the current script is running inside a single-executable application.

methods.name: getAsset
methods.description: Retrieves a bundled asset by key, optionally with specified encoding.

methods.name: getAssetAsBlob
methods.description: Retrieves a bundled asset as a Blob object.

methods.name: function getRawAsset(key: AssetKey): ArrayBuffer; getRawAsset
methods.description: Retrieves the raw bundled asset as an ArrayBuffer.

methods.name: getAssetKeys
methods.description: Returns an array of all embedded asset keys if running inside a single-executable application.
